rationale: Keep the existing 3 mm mean-depth gate. At 2-4 m and fx about 748 px, horizontal sampling is about 2.7-5.3 mm/pixel; fy about 1526 px provides finer vertical sampling. Two-pixel sampling/edge ambiguity motivates 10 mm patch, 15 mm corner/center and 20 mm dimension tolerances, with no GT-derived per-instance tuning. Ideal depth permits 1 mm robust-loss scale; 6 mm P95 exposes tails. One-degree normal/orientation accuracy is the application assumption. Calibration, resolution, SI depth and all fusion thresholds remain fixed.
